'''Saarcheen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In the second [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he took part in a dangerous expedition in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] with older Wookiees, and he witnessed the untimely death of his best friend [[Barraak]].

==Biography==
[[File:Pup_warriors.png|thumb|left|180px|Saarcheen and Barraak, pup warriors]]
{{Quote|It's not fair&hellip; It's not fair&hellip; He was my best friend.|Saarcheen, upon witnessing Barraak's brutal death|<ref name="CSS" />}}
Saarcheen was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]],<ref name="CSS" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] who lived in the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> In [[185 BBY]], he and his friend [[Barraak]] were still young [[Pup (Wookiee)|pups]]. They were training to become great warriors under the guidance of [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], an Wookiee teenager who had already gone through his [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk]] rite of passage and become an adult. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the two friends embarked with their seniors Tarffull, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Ralrracheen]] on a dangerous journey in Kashyyyk's [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]].<ref name="CSS" /> Those were the deepest, densest part of the Kashyyykian [[Tree/Legends|forest]] floor on the planet Kashyyyk, and were inhabited by savage beasts.<ref name="SoK">{{GamerCite|4|Secrets of Kashyyyk}}</ref>

While there, the group encountered a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who sought to ensare live Wookiees. Saarcheen was caught by [[Lix]], [[Rat/Legends|rat]]-like individual, but was rescued by Chewbacca. However, the encounter escalated into more violence, and Saarcheen saw his best friend Barraak [[Death/Legends|die]] while trying to fight Lix. Crushed with grief, Saarcheen was taken back to the higher levels of the forest by Ralrracheen, while Chewbacca and Tarfful stayed in the Shadowlands to fight the slavers.<ref name="CSS" />

==Personality and traits==
Saarcheen was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Wookiee pup. He sported a thick coat of silver [[Hair/Legends|fur]] with darker markings on both his [[Breast/Legends|chest]] and the top of his head. While still a [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] by Wookiee standards, he was eager to prove his worth. He was also a devoted friend, showing respect to Tarfful and sharing a great complicity with Barraak. When the latter died, Saarcheen burst into tears.<ref name="CSS" />
